description: This is a test class for the LanguageDao component within the OrangeHRM application's admin plugin. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations and validations related to languages, such as adding, editing, retrieving by id or name, listing, and deletion.

classes.name: LanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of LanguageDao, including adding, editing, fetching, deletion, and validation of languages in the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of LanguageDao and populating test data.

methods.name: testAddLanguage
methods.description: Tests the addition of a new Language entity and verifies it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditLanguage
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Language entity and verifies the changes were persisted.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Language by its ID and verifies the fetched data.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Language entries by their IDs and verifies the correct number of deletions.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests the delete operation with non-existent IDs and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks whether the language name existence validation correctly detects existing names irrespective of case and whitespace.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Language by name with different case and whitespace variations, and confirms the correct object is returned or not.
